digest: Importance Current treatment for type 1 retinopathy of prematurity (ROP), including laser photocoagulation and intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor therapy, is invasive but necessary to prevent blindness.
One eye drop was administered every day or every other day for up to 12 weeks.

72150fcaab225cf6.title: Validation of clinical and preclinical obesity across global cohorts
digest: A large-scale data analysis assesses the Lancet Commission’s proposed diagnostic framework for obesity, finding that this framework, in which BMI is combined with other criteria, such as waist circumference and organ function, is more useful than classifications based on BMI alone.

evidence.quote: Validation of clinical and preclinical obesity across global cohorts.

e6f6a222a2cd9b7c.title: Scaling productive aging to mitigate cumulative disadvantage
digest: Productive engagement among older adults — which spans employment, volunteering and family caregiving — functions as a multidimensional driver of healthspan, economic stability and social cohesion across individual and societal levels.
Here we advocate for a paradigmatic shift from observational research towards intersectional, experimental interventions designed to mitigate cumulative, life-course disadvantages.

evidence.quote: Scaling productive aging to mitigate cumulative disadvantage.

digest: Jurmeister et al. present a multicenter single-nucleus RNA sequencing atlas of lung cancer combined with spatial transcriptomics and clinical outcomes, delineating cancer–host cell interactions and uncovering tumor subtypes associated with metastatic relapse.

digest: A massive scientific collaboration meant to unravel the mysteries of the human brain has produced the most detailed map yet of the basal ganglia, a region closely associated with a wide array of psychiatric and neurologic disorders.
In the process scientists discovered a new type of neuron that appears to play a role in schizophrenia.
They also identified cell types linked to depression, bipolar disorder, and post-traumatic stress disorder.

digest: Our knowledge that social factors can influence health is abundant and has shaped research and policy across medicine, public health and society for decades.
